metadata.title: New certified lower bounds for the moving sofa problem in a three-dimensional snaky corridor
metadata.abstract: Consider the "snaky" corridor $K_4 \subset \mathbb{R}^3$ from Problem 6.64 of arXiv:2511.02864 : a tube of unit-square cross-section whose two right-angle turns lie in perpendicular planes, with a straight middle section of clear length $4$. We exhibit explicit rigid motions of connected bodies through $K_4$ and certify their volumes with the problem's own evaluation pipeline, unmodified, at the tight motion tolerances of its final scoring stage (translation $0.005$, rotation $0.05$ degrees). The certificates give $V^*(K_4) \ge 1.8355162$ at grid fineness $0.002$ and $V^*(K_4) \ge 1.8558404$ at grid fineness $0.001$, against the previously reported $1.81$; rerunning the pipeline's published best path under the identical configuration yields $1.8179428$, so every comparison is path against path under one fixed certifier. Three stages produce the record motion: a simple "staggered twist" backbone in which the whole 90-degree twist about the tube axis happens inside the second turn; evolutionary (CMA-ES) refinement, including a mixed-fidelity scheme that re-scores each generation's leading candidates on a grid twice as fine and lets those ranks steer recombination; and a gradient polish carried out directly at the finer carve resolution, guarded by periodic rebuilding of the frozen interpolation structure and by a penalty on control-pose spacing. These guards close three documented failure modes in which an optimizer inflates its own objective: frozen-structure inflation, spacing stretch, and exploitation of a coarse grid by optimizing and selecting on it. A staircase-based predictor with two grid bases, anchored by matching grid sensitivity, forecast the certificates to about $0.001$ before the runs. With the companion note's upper bound $V^*(K_4) \le 3.4083$, the problem now sits in the bracket $1.8558404 \le V^*(K_4) \le 3.4083$. All paths, notebooks and certified results are public.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.progressType: 三维走廊沙发认证构造下界
analysis.workSummary: 作者在固定三维走廊K4及统一评估配置下，用扭转骨架、CMA-ES与细网格梯度优化，将流程报告值提升至1.8558404。该数字要成为连通实体积的严密下界，仍依赖尚未证明的points-to-cubes转换；正文只无条件证明采样点的连续轨迹留在走廊内，并未完成认证网格处的实体连通性检查。
techniques: 控制点间距与插值刷新
analysis.breakthrough: 在同一评估器和相同容差下改进明确路径，并识别优化器利用离散目标的三个失效模式。
analysis.limitations: Remark2.5明确体素计数缺口；认证网格h=0.001/0.002只导出计数，连通性证据来自较粗网格。最终计数未用验证算术重跑，故1.8558404是条件性体积下界报告，不能作为已严密确定的下界。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 Claude 协助润色论文表述并编写部分代码。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者披露 Claude 协助润色论文表述并编写部分代码。

analysis.priorityReason: 空间运动优化中的可复现构造与误差控制。
